description: LmdbError implements std::error::Error but has no source() implementation. The Other(String) variant is constructed via heed::Error::to_string(), losing the original error chain. Using thiserror with #[error(transparent)] for the Other variant or preserving the heed::Error would improve diagnostics.
title: lmdb: LmdbError does not implement std::error::Error::source; Other(String) loses original heed error
